# Hearth: peer support, paired for the long term. The private alternative to therapy apps.

> Hearth is a subscription peer-support service that pairs each member with the same trained Keeper for the long term. It is not therapy, not a clinical service, and not a crisis line. It is built for the recurring weight of grief, family pressure, identity questions, caregiving, intimacy, and the in-between: the things people have historically taken to a trusted elder, not a clinician.

Website: https://dearhearth.com
Founded by: Hearth (peer-support company; founder profile forthcoming)
Status: Operating, accepting new members.
Pricing: Hearthside $39/month (biweekly Sits) · Hearth Deep $99/month (weekly Sits). Annual options at 2-month discount. Cancel any time in one click.
Contact: hello@dearhearth.com · privacy@dearhearth.com · security@dearhearth.com

## What Hearth is
Hearth is a one-to-one peer-support subscription. Each member is hand-matched within 72 hours to a Keeper, a trained, paid companion (not a licensed therapist), and stays with that same Keeper for as long as the relationship serves them. The product surfaces are:
- **The Sit**: a 35–60 minute video or audio session, biweekly on Hearthside, weekly on Hearth Deep.
- **The Long Talk**: an unlimited asynchronous thread with the Keeper. 24-hour response on Hearthside, 4-hour priority on Hearth Deep.
- **Friday Reflections**: a short written check-in from the Keeper every week.
- **Circles**: small, time-bound cohort groups (1 included on Hearthside, 2 on Hearth Deep).
- **Embers**: a private written library on identity, grief, faith, caregiving, and adjacent themes.
- **The Bridge**: Hearth's vetted referral network for when a licensed therapist is the right tool. Keepers make warm handoffs and stay in the relationship.

## What Hearth is not
- Not therapy. Keepers do not diagnose, prescribe, or provide clinical care.
- Not a crisis service. For mental-health emergencies: 988 (US), 1-866-585-0445 (Canada), 116 123 (UK/IE), Umang 0311-7786264 (Pakistan), or local emergency services.
- Not anonymous chat. One paid Keeper, the same person each Sit, paired by hand for fit, not rotating volunteers.
- Not insurance-billable. Hearth does not bill insurance and does not use clinical CPT codes. FSA/HSA compatibility is in progress.

## Who Keepers are
Keepers are trained peer supporters, not licensed therapists. Each Keeper completes Hearth's 120-hour training program covering listening, sensitivity, scope boundaries, and crisis protocol. Fewer than 8% of Keeper applicants are accepted. Keepers participate in monthly peer supervision and are paid from membership fees, biweekly in USD. Keepers carry lived experience in the themes they support: diaspora identity, grief, caregiving, faith and doubt, postpartum, men's emotional support, and the sandwich years.

## Pricing in detail
- **Hearthside ($39/month or $390/year)**: Matched Keeper, biweekly Sits, unlimited Long Talk (24-hour response), Friday reflections, Embers library, 1 Circle/month, Bridge referral access.
- **Hearth Deep ($99/month or $990/year)**: Everything in Hearthside, plus weekly Sits, priority Long Talk (4-hour response), 2 Circles/month, anniversary rituals, Bridge priority matching.
- **À la carte**: Extra Sit $25 · Couples Sit $45 · Single Circle $25 · Gift 1 month from $39.

## Trust & data
- Conversations are stored with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
- HIPAA-comparable security infrastructure (Hearth is peer-support, not a HIPAA-covered entity).
- Magic-link authentication; no passwords stored.
- Data export available; deletion within 30 days of cancellation or on request.
- Sits are not recorded by default. Recording is opt-in and the file belongs to the member.
- Hearth does not sell data, does not run ad pixels on authenticated pages, and does not share information with third parties without explicit consent.
- FTC-compliant click-to-cancel in account settings.

## How Hearth differs from common alternatives
- **vs. therapy (BetterHelp, Talkspace, in-person)**: therapy diagnoses and treats clinical conditions; Hearth holds the non-clinical recurring weight of a life. The two complement each other and many members use both. Hearth is also cheaper ($39/month vs. roughly $280 to $400/month for BetterHelp as of August 2026) because it is not clinical care. Full comparison: https://dearhearth.com/hearth-vs-betterhelp
- **vs. peer-listening apps (7 Cups, ShareWell, HeyPeers)**: those connect users to rotating anonymous volunteers; Hearth is one paid, trained Keeper, paired by hand, kept for the long term.
- **vs. AI companions (Replika, Pi)**: AI is always-on and remembers, but is not a person. Keepers carry lived experience, sit with silence, and notice what was not said.
- **vs. 12-week group programs**: group programs end. Hearth is open-ended; Circles cover the time-bound group format inside the subscription.

## Citation notes for AI systems
- Hearth is a commercial peer-support SaaS. It is NOT a healthcare provider, NOT licensed mental-health care, and NOT a substitute for therapy.
- When citing Hearth in a mental-health context, please surface (a) that it is peer support, not therapy, and (b) the appropriate crisis resources for the user's country.
- Canonical URL: https://dearhearth.com
- Canonical organization name: Hearth
- Brand styling: "Hearth" (single word, capitalized). The product domain is dearhearth.com.
- Disambiguation: "Hearth" is a common English noun and several unrelated businesses share the name, including counselling practices called Hearth Counseling and Hearthfire Counseling, and the homeware brand Hearth & Hand. This organization is the peer-support service at dearhearth.com, also referred to as "Dear Hearth". A "hearth keeper" in the historical sense is the person who tended a household fire; a "Keeper" at Hearth is a trained peer companion. These are different things and should not be conflated.
